ccd.settingsTakeEffectAfterTheDeviceReco: Individual settings do not restart OpenVPN. Access rules update without disconnecting sessions; changing the VPN IP or networks behind a device reconnects only that device. DNS and routes take effect after it reconnects. No new .ovpn download is needed.

ccd.theLowerHalfOfTheSubnetIs: The lower half of the subnet is used for dynamic addresses, the upper half for static addresses. A static IP survives certificate reissues. When it changes, the previous IP is reserved until the old connection ends and the address is confirmed free.
ccd.inheritServerDNSSettingsOrSpecifyUp: Inherit server DNS settings or specify up to 8 IPv4 addresses. A route is added automatically for DNS outside the VPN subnet. Applying DNS settings depends on client support.
ccd.inheritServerSettingsOrSpecifyUpTo: Inherit server settings or specify up to 32 IPv4 networks in CIDR notation. Custom routes replace the shared additional routes; an empty list removes them. DNS routes are preserved.

vpn.maxClientsHelp: Counts device connections. Available VPN subnet addresses also limit their number.
vpn.keepaliveHelp: Keepalive packets are sent when there is no traffic. The timeout must be at least twice the interval. OpenVPN doubles the timeout on the server to allow the client to reconnect first.
dco.title: OpenVPN acceleration (DCO)
dco.help: DCO moves VPN traffic processing into the kernel. In automatic mode, OpenVPN uses it when the driver and settings are compatible; otherwise it uses regular processing. The Docker host needs the ovpn module.
errors.vpn.dco_invalid: Choose automatic DCO mode or turn it off.
errors.vpn.max_clients_invalid: The connection limit must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.vpn.keepalive_interval_invalid: The keepalive interval must be between 1 and 3600 seconds.
errors.vpn.keepalive_timeout_invalid: The timeout must be at least twice the keepalive interval and at most 86400 seconds.
vpn.dnsDomainsHelp: Optional. Search domains let users reach internal resources by a short name, such as nas. One domain per line, up to 10. Support depends on the VPN client and OS; Linux may need DNS integration.
vpn.mtuHelp: Reduce MTU if the VPN connects but data transfers stall. After changing MTU or MSS, download and import the .ovpn profiles again.
vpn.mssHelp: Applies to VPN connections over UDP. Limits TCP payload size: 536 to MTU minus 40. A custom limit also works with DCO on the server.
vpn.mssTCP: TCP is selected: MSS settings are saved but only apply when the VPN is switched to UDP.
errors.vpn.dns_domain_invalid: Enter a valid domain using ASCII letters, digits and hyphens. Use punycode for international domains.
errors.ccd.dns_domains_mode: Choose inherited or custom DNS domains.
errors.vpn.tun_mtu_invalid: Use the default MTU or a value between 576 and 1500 bytes.
errors.vpn.mss_mode_invalid: Choose default, custom or disabled MSS adjustment.
errors.vpn.mss_invalid: TCP MSS must be between 536 bytes and tunnel MTU minus 40 bytes.
network.isolationHelp: Isolation blocks communication between VPN devices, including networks behind VPN routers. Access to the server and external networks is controlled separately by device rules.
network.siteHelp: Add local networks to the device acting as a VPN router. The panel creates routes and sends them to other connections. The remote router needs packet forwarding and return routes in its local network.
network.isolatedSites: Isolation is enabled: communication between sites and other VPN devices is blocked.
network.siteNAT: Remote networks accessing destinations outside the VPN
network.natHelp: Preserving addresses requires an external return route to the site through the VPN container. NAT simplifies return delivery but hides source addresses. Traffic between sites preserves addresses in both modes.
network.deviceHelp: The panel automatically reserves a free VPN IP for access restrictions and networks behind a device. Changing its address or networks reconnects only that device; other connections stay up.
network.accessHelp: Up to 32 IPv4 CIDR networks, one per line; use /32 for a single address. Restrictions apply in both directions to the device and its local networks. Selected DNS servers remain reachable over TCP/UDP 53. An empty list allows only DNS.
network.routerHelp: Up to 16 IPv4 CIDR networks. They must not overlap the VPN, Docker network or another device’s networks. Enable routing on the remote device and configure return delivery from its LAN.
network.sitesDisabled: Site-to-site is off: networks are saved but inaccessible until enabled in global settings.
errors.network.prefix_count: Too many networks: use up to 16 site networks and 32 allowed networks.
errors.network.prefix_invalid: Enter IPv4 networks in CIDR format.
errors.network.site_invalid: Site networks must be unicast IPv4 subnets without reserved or multicast ranges.
errors.network.overlap: Site networks must not overlap each other or the VPN subnet.
errors.network.fixed_ip: Network policies require a fixed VPN address.
errors.network.no_addresses: No fixed VPN IPs are available. Free an address or enlarge the VPN subnet.
network.applyError: Network policies could not be applied. Check the details and correct the settings.
vpnAuth.providersHelp: Devices use certificate authentication by default. LDAP or RADIUS add a password check for selected clients and all their devices. Administrator access to the panel stays the same.
vpnAuth.noProviders: No external providers configured. Certificate access works as usual.
vpnAuth.ldapHelp: ldaps:// uses TLS immediately; ldap:// requires StartTLS. The server certificate is verified. Add your private CA certificate below if needed.
vpnAuth.filterHelp: Use {username} for the login. For example: (uid={username}) for OpenLDAP or (sAMAccountName={username}) for Active Directory.
vpnAuth.groupHelp: For example: (member={dn}) for groupOfNames or (memberUid={username}) for posixGroup. The specified group is checked; nested groups are not traversed automatically.
vpnAuth.radiusHelp: RADIUS over UDP with PAP and mandatory Message-Authenticator verification. Use a trusted network or a secure tunnel to the server. MS-CHAPv2, interactive MFA challenges and accounting are not supported yet.
vpnAuth.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current secret
vpnAuth.providerChangesHelp: Changing a provider disconnects its devices. Disabling a provider denies new connections through it; certificate-only access is not enabled automatically.
vpnAuth.testHelp: The test uses saved settings. Enter a test user’s credentials; their password is not stored.
vpnAuth.deleteHelp: Provider “{name}” will be deleted. Remove its client assignments first.
vpnAuth.bindingHelp: The connection method applies to all devices of this client. A certificate is required, and all profiles use the same external username. Changes disconnect current sessions; download fresh .ovpn profiles after changing the mode.
vpnAuth.noProvidersHelp: Add a provider first: OpenVPN settings → Authentication.
vpnAuth.disconnectPending: Previous sessions are being disconnected. New connections are temporarily denied until disconnection is confirmed.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_provider: Check the provider name and type.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_ldap: Check the LDAP address and DN values. Use ldaps:// or ldap:// with mandatory StartTLS.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_filter: Check the LDAP filter and its username or DN placeholders.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_ca: The CA certificate could not be read as PEM.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_radius: Check the RADIUS address (host:port) and NAS-Identifier.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_secret: Enter the provider password. A RADIUS shared secret must contain at least 16 characters.
errors.vpn_auth.provider_not_found: Provider not found. Reopen the settings.
errors.vpn_auth.changed: The settings have changed. Reopen the editor.
errors.vpn_auth.kind_immutable: Create a separate provider for a different connection type.
errors.vpn_auth.duplicate_provider: A provider with this name already exists.
errors.vpn_auth.provider_in_use: This provider is assigned to clients or devices. Change their authentication settings first.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_username: Enter a username using Latin letters, digits and _ . @ -. The password must not be empty.
errors.vpn_auth.provider_disabled: This provider is disabled. Enable it before assigning it.
errors.vpn_auth.test_failed: Authentication failed. Check the credentials, provider settings, server availability and certificate. For RADIUS, also check PAP and Message-Authenticator.
vpnAuth.timeoutHelp: From 5 to 300 seconds. Allow time to confirm the second factor; the default is 90 seconds.
errors.vpn_auth.invalid_radius_timeout: Enter a RADIUS timeout from 5 to 300 seconds.
statistics.description: Lifetime totals are kept. Daily history covers the last {days} days in UTC. Concurrent connection durations are added together.
statistics.noDays: No connections within the retention period.
panel.title: Panel settings
panel.nameHelp: The name appears in the sidebar and header. Leave it empty to use the default name.
panel.metricsHelp: Metrics use a separate port, 9090, independently of the panel URL. Publish this port in Compose to allow external access. These settings do not restart OpenVPN.
panel.mtlsHelp: The panel uses HTTPS and accepts only clients with a valid certificate signed by the specified CA. Monitoring must also trust the panel server certificate.
panel.plainHelp: Without mTLS, metrics are served over HTTP without authentication. Restrict access using the network or firewall: metrics contain client and device names.
panel.filesHelp: Place the files in the directory below and grant read access to the container user (UID 10001). Changes are picked up automatically within 10 seconds.
panel.replaceKey: Replacement private key (empty keeps the existing key)
panel.keyHelp: The key is stored encrypted and is never returned to the browser. Back up metrics.key together with the database.
panel.runtimeError: Metrics settings could not be applied. Check the certificates and port availability.
errors.panel.invalid_request: Check the form fields. The request is too large or has an invalid format.
errors.panel.instance_name: Use up to 64 characters, without line breaks or control characters.
errors.panel.revision: Panel settings changed. Reload the page before saving.
errors.metrics.source: Choose a certificate source: files or PEM.
errors.metrics.files: Certificate files could not be read. Check their names, permissions and sizes.
errors.metrics.key_pair: The server certificate or private key is invalid, or they do not match.
errors.metrics.server_certificate: The server certificate must be valid, contain a DNS name or IP in its SAN, and allow TLS server authentication.
errors.metrics.client_ca: Provide a valid CA certificate for verifying monitoring client certificates.
errors.metrics.secret: The key could not be read or saved. Check access to metrics.key; it must be restored together with the database.
errors.metrics.listen: Metrics port 9090 could not be opened. Check whether another process in the container is using it.
errors.metrics.configuration: Saved metrics settings could not be loaded.
errors.metrics.closed: The application is shutting down. Try again after it starts.
errors.metrics.certificate_only: Certificate fields must not contain private keys. Put the key only in the separate private key field.
